## Context
The retired seam guard `tests/scripts/test_reconciler_core_seam_clean_heldout.py` was deleted, but 7 function docstrings were copied byte-for-byte into current `tests/unit/test_reconciler_repo_root_c0b9.py`. The 73-word error case and 65-word Git-probe case still carry fix history and plan-review narration; the module docstring also states obsolete move history. This current file is absent from the closed `linguistic-dental-eyra` remediation Scope. Origin/main basis: `b65dc0c825274676a0957c57a703b1fc17e83ddd`.

## Scope and plan
Condense only 8 leading docstrings in that current file: `D:<module>`, `D:_noneditable_package_config_file`, `D:test_repo_root_precedence_is_preserved`, `D:test_reconciler_event_identity_env_override_propagates`, `D:test_reconciler_repo_root_errors_when_neither_package_nor_cwd_is_a_checkout`, `D:test_reconciler_repo_root_git_probe_failure_degrades_to_clear_error`, `D:test_reconciler_repo_root_falls_back_to_cwd_checkout_under_noneditable_install`, and `D:test_reconciler_repo_root_preserves_env_and_editable_behavior`. Keep the root precedence, wheel/noneditable fallback, clear REBAR_ROOT/--repo-root remedy, Git probe failure handling, and editable/env controls. Preserve every executable AST node, directive, assertion, fixture value, and nonlisted comment. Record exact before/final citations and strict word reductions. Run focused pytest, scoped Ruff/format, comment hygiene, diff check, and full `make verify` from the worktree venv. Send this leaf with the rich-text seam follow-up as 1 grouped Gerrit change.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Exactly 8 allowlisted docstrings are shorter and all other prose is unchanged.
- [x] The 5 named resolver contracts remain explicit and the test behavior/AST are unchanged.
- [x] A nonauthor reviewer agent posts 8 leaf-linked TSV rows with full before/final SHA:path#stable-ID citations, contract, before/after words, directive exactness, semantic preservation, bloat removal, and reviewer session; every verdict is PASS.
- [x] All recorded focused, structural, hygiene, diff, and untimed full verification commands exit 0.
- [x] The grouped Gerrit change receives LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, zero unresolved comments, merges, and exact merged-SHA review receipts are read back.
- [x] Standalone completion verification passes and the ticket closes after merge.
